name: Soul of the Sorcerer
body:
Associated Skills: Bluff, Intimidate, Knowledge (arcana), Spellcraft

Associated Veils: Banelight Vortices, Bangles of the Jealous Seductress, Crown of Elemental Mastery, Ebon Blaze, Gorget of the Wyrm, Ionizing Scarf, Mai’yr’s Band, Sabatons of the Storm

Bloodline Soul (Su)

At 1st level, the power of the sorcerer’s soul imbues your body with the bloodline of an ancient and powerful creature.

When you forge this soul, select one sorcerer bloodline. You cannot already possess this bloodline from another source.

You gain the first-level bloodline power for the selected bloodline.

At 5th level, you gain the selected bloodline’s 3rd level ability.

At 11th level, you gain the selected bloodline’s 9th level ability.

At 17th level, you gain the selected bloodline’s 15th level ability.

You use your soulforge level as your sorcerer level and your Wisdom in place of your Charisma when determining the effects of these bloodline abilities.
